summary: Quanome Technologies filed a routine 8-K on September 16, 2026 disclosing a Purchase and Sale Agreement and related purchase order with Compal Electronics for 32 GPU server units at an aggregate price of approximately US$18.8 million. Payment terms require 20% after purchase-order acceptance and the remaining 80% prior to shipment, with delivery expected to a US data center for the company's AI computing infrastructure build-out. No securities, ownership stake, board recommendation, advisor, or deal-structure terms are involved. This is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation; watch execution and delivery risk only.
